referenceFunction.generalComment: Assumption for the construction of the canal are derived from the Main-Donau-Canal in Germany. The canal is characterised by a width of 42 m and a average depth of 4m. Life time of port is assumed to be 118 years. The canal bed area is estimated with 42m2. In addition, 10 meters at each edge is modelled as road traffic area.; UUID: aff347f1-609b-30a4-9bd8-316ccf244491
